chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni narrated to us; he said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to me, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa — all together from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
In the Book of Ali (peace be upon him), concerning the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
'and what you have taught of the hunting animals, trained ones'

key_terms.الجوارح: Hunting animals (literally 'those that wound/catch prey'). In Quran 5:4 this term refers to trained predatory animals used for hunting.
key_terms.الكلاب: Dogs — specifically trained hunting dogs whose game is permissible to eat according to Quran 5:4
key_terms.كتاب علي: The Book of Ali — a book of jurisprudential rulings dictated by the Prophet and written down by Imam Ali (AS), preserved and transmitted by his descendants.
key_terms.مكلبين: Dog-trainers or those who use trained dogs for hunting. The term comes from kalb (dog) and refers to those trained in this practice.

ai.seo_question: What animals does 'al-jawarih' refer to in Quran 5:4 according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) cited the Book of Ali (AS) when interpreting Quran 5:4, specifying that the 'hunting animals' (al-jawarih) mentioned in the verse refer specifically to dogs. This ruling established the jurisprudential foundation for the permissibility of consuming game hunted by trained dogs, a matter debated among early Muslim scholars. The reference to 'the Book of Ali' — a compilation attributed to Imam Ali (AS) — indicates that this legal interpretation has its source in the first Imam's teachings.

en.hubeali: Abu Muhammad Haroun Bin Musa Al Talakbary narrated to us, from Abu Ja’far Muhammad Bin Yaqoub Al Kulayni, from Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, altogether, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Halby, Abu Abdullahasws has said: ‘In the Book of Aliasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [5:4] and what you have taught the hunting animals, trained ones.
en.sarwar: 1. Narrated to us abu Muhammad Harun ibn Musa al-Tal‘akbariy, who has said that narrated to us abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub al- Kulayniy, who has said that narrated to him Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa. All of them have narrated from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman from al-Halabiy who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is in the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the meaning of the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious,
. . and whatever of the hunting beasts you may train. . .
He (the Imam) has said, ‘It is a reference to (hunting) dogs.’”
